newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-BOSNICH STORMS AWAY FROM MATCH BEFORE KICK-OFF.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BOSNICH STORMS AWAY FROM MATCH BEFORE KICK-OFF.

text.p: Australian international goalkeeper Mark Bosnich faces disciplinary action from Aston Villa manager Brian Little for storming away from the ground after being named only as a substitute to face Derby on Saturday.
Bosnich left the Baseball Ground an hour before kick-off after Little announced that Bosnich would be on the substitutes' bench and his deputy Michael Oakes would play instead.
After the game, which Derby won 2-1, Little confirmed that Bosnich had stormed off before the match started.
"Mark was to be on the bench again and the next thing I know at five minutes to two, I am told he has left the ground," he said.
Little confirmed Bosnich may face disciplinary action, saying: "I will see him on Monday and sort it out and I would think it might be a disciplinary matter."

Bosnich was in trouble earlier this season when he was fined 1,000 pounds ($1,600) by the English Football Association for making a Hitler-style salute at Tottenham, a club with a large Jewish following, when Villa played at White Hart Lane last October.
